name: skill-heaven
description: Working prototype of Skill Heaven for Claude Code, actively tested for public use. One mechanic — /summon, one skill into context for one session, nothing installed — on one line: off · low · med · high · xhigh · max · ultra, whose four surfaces are contiguous bands read from the current rung. /skill-zero is the floor, /skill-heaven converges, /skill-hell explores, and /skill-ultra is the crown rung whose controller picks direction and depth per gap. Nothing on the line refuses. Per-rung counts are PROVISIONAL until the benchmark lands. Interfaces may change. The off-default launcher and standing-dose statusline live in the claude-zero package, run from a source checkout — not part of this marketplace install.
